memo.summary: Aurelia Income Trust holds global dividend payers at a mid-single-digit discount to NAV, with the board buying back shares.
memo.what_it_does: Investment trust holding ~60 global dividend payers, trading at a mid-single-digit discount to NAV.

products.name: Ordinary shares
products.what: the only class; eligible for UK tax wrappers

memo.how_it_earns: NAV total return plus a yield-enhanced global equity income portfolio; charges 0.6% a year.
bear: Global dividend cuts hit income and NAV together.
The discount can always widen before it narrows.
Outflows force selling into weak markets.
memo.bear_hardest: A sustained 15%+ discount with no buyback response means the market does not believe the book.
gaps: Unlisted positions are valued quarterly, not marked live.

tv.summary: Aurelia Income Trust is a fictional investment trust holding global dividend payers at a mid-single-digit discount to NAV.
tv.variant_view: The discount reflects a period of underperformance in 2025; the underlying book is unchanged and the board has started buying back shares.
tv.assumptions: ["buybacks continue while the discount persists","dividend maintained"]
tv.risks: Global dividend cuts; discount widening further if outflows resume.
tv.invalidation: Discount widens past 15% with no buyback response.
tv.exit_conditions: Thesis invalidated, or the position reaches its target weight through price alone.
tv.reason_for_change: Tightened the invalidation condition after the interim update.
